Portrait album organization vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Photos depth-effect capability on device covers storefront language. PhotoKit album routing, depth-effect classification, and Connect actually separate in-app Portrait album behavior from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Portrait — the system smart album where depth-effect portrait stills collect on the buyer's device (often listed under Media Types). Controls on-device organization — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Depth-effect portrait stills — photos captured with Portrait Mode or equivalent depth metadata that Photos routes into the Portrait album. Product-page copy should describe that library path; building depth capture UI is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Portrait photos in the Portrait album — grouped depth-effect stills distinct from flat photos in Recents or front-camera shots in Selfies. Listing copy names that path; building album-grid UI is engineering.
  • Soft background blur & depth effect — buyer-facing value props on portrait grid frames. zh-Hans overlays should use 背景虚化 or 景深 when your English gallery shows blur badges — not generic photo-library copy.
  • Find portraits vs Recents or all photos — buyers open the Portrait album to locate depth-effect shots instead of scrolling Camera Roll or Recents. Listing copy names that path; building search or album UI is engineering.
  • Find portraits vs Selfies, Live Photos, or Videos — product-page copy may describe why front-camera selfies stay in Selfies, motion stills in Live Photos, and clips in Videos when your English listing claims that workflow.
  • Camera Portrait Mode (different surface) — iPhone Camera capture mode for shooting new depth-effect stills: Portrait Mode, Studio Light, 人像模式. Covered on our Portrait Mode guide — capture-mode marketing, not the Photos Portrait album grid hero unless your frames show album browsing only.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Portrait album support in the binary.

Working Portrait album organization and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Portrait, 人像相簿, and 景深 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you wire depth maps in code.
